stories.title: Trump waives 100% tariff on Russian oil, offering India temporary relief
stories.summary: The United States announced a waiver of the threatened 100% tariff on Russian oil for buyers, including India. GTRI warned the relief is temporary and duties could be reinstated, citing U.S. purchases of Russian diesel, tariff protection for China, and ongoing India‑U.S. trade talks as possible reasons. The think‑tank urged New Delhi to protect its energy security and avoid permanent trade concessions.
stories.why: Trade developments can affect currencies, business costs, market access and the external balance of the economies involved.
stories.previousTitle: Trump waives 100% tariff on Russian oil, GTRI says relief for India is temporary
stories.previousSummary: The Global Trade and Investment (GTRI) think tank said that President Donald Trump’s waiver of a threatened 100 percent tariff on Russian oil imports gives India only temporary relief, because the United States could reinstate the duties at any time. GTRI noted ongoing U.S. purchases of Russian diesel, tariff protection for China and current India‑U.S. trade talks as possible reasons, and urged New Delhi to protect its energy security and avoid permanent trade concessions.
stories.change: Material facts or figures changed since the previous brief.

stories.title: Trump suspends Russia sanctions days before they take effect amid dispute with Zelensky
stories.summary: On Friday night President Donald Trump issued an executive order suspending a group of Russia sanctions that Congress had passed and he had signed into law, delaying them by two days before they were scheduled to become effective. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky condemned the action as a disregard for the sanctions. The move comes as relations between Washington and Kyiv have soured following a U.S. deal to import Russian diesel and Kyiv’s claim that the administration has cut key military support.
stories.why: The suspension could reduce U.S. pressure on Russia and further strain cooperation between the United States and Ukraine.
stories.previousTitle: Trump suspends Russia sanctions amid dispute with Zelensky
stories.previousSummary: Donald Trump issued an executive order on Friday night to suspend several Russia sanctions that were scheduled to take effect two days later, saying the pause was in the U.S. “national interest.” The sanctions had been passed by Congress and signed into law by Trump in September. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky condemned the move as a complete disregard of the measures, amid a broader row that includes a U.S. deal to import Russian diesel and Ukrainian accusations of reduced military support.
stories.change: No material change since the previous brief.

stories.title: White House lists investment over $330 billion in US from India
stories.summary: The White House announced investments of over $330 billion from India as part of total investments. US President Donald Trump previously mentioned Reliance Industries' $300 billion investment in Texas.
stories.why: This matters because it could affect India’s economy, major industries, investment, jobs or trade.

stories.title: AI race may depend more on access to power, infrastructure than chip supply: Morgan Stanley
stories.summary: According to Morgan Stanley's latest analysis, the burgeoning AI infrastructure market is on track to experience a dire electricity shortfall by 2028. A predicted 32-gigawatt power deficit threatens data-center development and chip deployment.
